meta.label: Table storage (Oracle, PostgreSQL)
meta.description: Space the table of the dataset takes in its database, by family of objects: table data, indexes, LOB (TOAST on PostgreSQL) and other. Sizes in MB, storage units, indexes, LOB columns, partitions, tablespaces, compression.

params.name: about
params.description: Metrics: total_mb, table_mb, index_mb, lob_mb, other_mb; total_segments and the segments of each family; n_indexes, n_lob_columns, partitioned, n_partitions, n_subpartitions, n_tablespaces, tablespaces, compression (Oracle). Always the whole table, also when computed on one partition of the dataset.

params.name: read_connection
params.label: Read through connection
params.description: Optional. Another connection to the same database, e.g. an account with dictionary rights. Empty: the dataset's own connection.

params.name: oracle_dictionary
params.label: Oracle dictionary

selectChoices.label: Automatic: DBA views, else the login user's

params.description: Without SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE, Oracle only shows the sizes of the tables of the login user.
